title: Sewerat's Community Beastmen Add-on (Pt.1)
author: Sk_Sewer Rat
description:
***you can replace older versions with the newer one

Hi, I am making an add-on mod for the main Community Beastmen.

The purpose of this mod is to make the Beastmen as a faction fits more into the narrative of Community Beastmen mod.

What this mod does:

-add new skills for generic lords and heroes: 4 for each generic lords and 2 for heroes

-add new abilities for certain generic lords and heroes

My plan for PT.1:

-reskin/rewrite passive abilities; for example, Primal Fury -> Primal Lust

-adding new active abilities for certain generic lords and heroes

-changing images for each skill due to my ethical concern (I will address it more in notes section)

===============================================

My future plan:

There will be a part-two of this mod. The second part content is all about hunting down female legendary lords and by doing so, you will be met with a dilemma: receive a powerful buff or corrupted items of each defeated female legendary lord. The cover arts will be made by me using either SFM or Blender

I'm currently working on it. Something may be changed but for the better.

===============================================

Notes:

-This mod might be overpowered in some aspects of gameplay but after some testing from me and my testers; I can conclude that it is still somewhat balanced. All new added skills and abilities does not provide any extra power toward auto-resolve.

-My English when it comes to writing smut is mediocre at best which is why I asked some of the writers to help me. You can find their names in the special thanks section.

-Though, all of images are under fair-use; I am still obligated to replace some of them which their creators have not yet to respond to my messages. The borrowed contents are only noticeable in certain parts of the gameplay.

-I've learned so much about modding Total War during the creation of this mod, and I am looking forward to learn more about it. Currently, I'm quite familiar with modeling but I have no idea how to script which I have to study more about it.
